manifest.title: “Svii dlia Svoikh” — a Ukrainian social network and business platform
manifest.i1: “Svii dlia Svoikh” (“One of Our Own, for Our Own”) is a Ukrainian social network and business platform that unites consumers and entrepreneurs. Created by Ukrainians for Ukrainians. 🇺🇦
manifest.i2: We are building a space where Ukrainians find each other, talk, support their own and build the future together — in Ukraine and abroad.
manifest.i3: Our goal is to unite Ukrainians all over the world and help everyone feel the strength of community. So that in your own city or far from home you can find fellow countrymen, friends, like-minded people, professionals and partners — people who will understand, support, advise or join your cause.
manifest.b1t: At the core of “Svii dlia Svoikh” is a social network and a platform for consumers and entrepreneurs.
manifest.b1p1: We combine everyday communication with opportunities for growth. Here you can share news, photos and stories, find Ukrainians nearby, create communities of interest, organise meetings and launch joint projects.
manifest.b1p2: It is also a space where a person who needs a product or service can find their own Ukrainian producer, entrepreneur or specialist. And whoever has knowledge, experience or a business of their own can present themselves and find clients, a team and new opportunities.
manifest.b1p3: By buying from our own, recommending our own and working together, we help Ukrainian families, support jobs and develop Ukrainian entrepreneurship.
manifest.b2t: Everyone has a talent. Together we help it unfold.
manifest.b2p1: Some are only looking for their path. Some already have a profession, are building a business or are ready to share experience. Some grow produce, make things by hand, teach, organise events or help their community.
manifest.b2p2: We want these abilities to find recognition, support and practical use — so that an idea can become a shared project, a hobby a business, and experience a valuable help to others.
manifest.b2p3: Even if your parents or relatives do not use social networks, you can help them present their work and find buyers and partners. This way digital opportunities become useful for whole families.
manifest.b3t: A community begins with getting acquainted and grows stronger through shared work.
manifest.b3p1: We build an environment for friendship, hobbies, learning, sport, volunteering and business. Here you can find company for leisure, join a useful initiative, gather a team or create a local chapter in your community.
manifest.b3p2: Around the platform we are developing the directions Ukrainians need in everyday life: education, professional services, entrepreneurship, travel, family support and other projects. Their development is based on real needs and the participation of our community.
manifest.b4t: To know your rights and have reliable legal support.
manifest.b4p1: An important direction of our work is developing legal help and the “Svii” law association. We aim to make quality consultations, legal support and defence more accessible to Ukrainians and their businesses, involving specialists according to the country and the specific issue.
manifest.b5t: Our community is created by each of us.
manifest.b5p1: Every useful tip, recommendation, purchase from our own, new acquaintance or joint initiative strengthens the bonds between Ukrainians.
manifest.b5p2: We believe in Ukraine and in the people who work for it every day; in the power of mutual support, responsibility and the ability to create more opportunities together for ourselves, our children and our country.
manifest.call: Join in. Find your own. Grow your business. Help others grow.
manifest.motto: “Svii dlia Svoikh” — a strong community, a strong society, a strong Ukraine.

overview.title: 📱 What is Sviy dlya Svoikh?
overview.intro: Sviy dlya Svoikh ("One of Our Own") is a free two-in-one platform: an entertainment social network and a business platform. People find their own kind by interests, share stories, photos and videos, chat with friends and spend time well.
overview.details: Alongside the social network there are many projects for business and everyday life: services, real estate, cars, jobs, shop, health, travel, interest clubs and more. Everyone sees what they need: some come in as to an ordinary social network, others find clients, partners and income. Register, come in, explore the projects and follow the news. The platform works in Ukrainian and English, and the catalog is available without registration.

mission.title: 🎯 Our Mission
mission.text: We built a platform that brings together the Ukrainian diaspora and the wider community to help one another in running businesses and finding services. Our goal is to support our own people and build a community of trust, where everyone can find the services they need from people who share common values.

purpose.title: 🧭 What the platform is for
purpose.intro: The purpose of the platform is to help people find each other for services and business cooperation:

items.find: find a service provider by category and city;
items.publish: present your services and business to a wide audience;
items.contact: contact a provider directly — through a request or chat;
items.trust: choose based on other users' reviews and ratings.

trust.label: Trust:
trust.text: All members follow high ethical standards

support.label: Support:
support.text: Every deal supports your own business, your family and your community

quality.label: Quality:
quality.text: The ratings and reviews system helps maintain a high level of service

convenience.label: Convenience:
convenience.text: Finding the service or client you need is now quick and easy

who.title: 👥 Who can use the platform
who.intro: The platform is for individuals and entrepreneurs. When registering, you choose one of three profile types:

viewer.name: Viewer
viewer.text: Browse the catalog, profiles and services, and save favorites. You can switch to a regular profile for free.

individual.name: Regular (individual)
individual.text: A full profile, publishing services, requests, messages and reviews.

business.name: Business
business.text: A business profile for companies and entrepreneurs: business information, services, requests, messages and reviews.

who.free: Using the platform and listing services is free of charge.

catalog.label: Catalog and search:
catalog.text: find services and providers by category and city.

profiles.label: Profiles:
profiles.text: user profiles and business profiles with a description, contacts and photos.

services.label: Services:
services.text: publish and edit your own services with a description and images.

requests.label: Requests:
requests.text: send a request to a provider, or publish an open request that other users can respond to.

favorites.label: Favorites:
favorites.text: save the profiles and services you need.

reviews.label: Reviews and ratings:
reviews.text: rate providers from 1 to 5 and leave a comment.

reports.label: Reports:
reports.text: report a user, service, request, review or message; reports are reviewed by the administration.

registration.title: 📝 How registration works

steps.choose: Open the registration page and choose a profile type: viewer, regular or business.
steps.fill: Fill in the form: first name, last name, email and password (at least 6 characters). Phone, city and profile photo are optional.
steps.done: After registering, you are signed in right away and can complete your profile.
steps.login: Next time, sign in with your email and password.

registration.note: A viewer can switch to a regular profile for free at any time.

security.title: 🔒 How user information is protected
security.intro: We apply the following protection measures:

items.passwords: Passwords are stored only as hashes (bcrypt) — the plain-text password is never stored.
items.sessions: Sign-in is maintained with session tokens in secure cookies (httpOnly; in production, sent over HTTPS only).
items.https: The website and the app work over a secure HTTPS connection.
items.limits: The number of sign-in and registration attempts is limited to make password guessing harder.
items.access: Actions that require an account (messages, requests, reviews) are available only to signed-in users.
items.deletion: You can delete your account yourself (password confirmation required) — the related data is deleted.
